The '''Hettitite system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hettitite]], which was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Near-Human]] [[Sernpidalian|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point, Hettitite became threatened by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], and in [[365 BBY]], members of the native [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] the planet [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]] in the [[Julevian system]], eventually becoming known as Sernpidalans.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hettitite system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and which placed it in grid square M-2.<ref name="TEA" />
